name: What is topic cluster creation in digital marketing?

mainEntity.name: What is topic cluster creation in digital marketing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Topic cluster creation is a content strategy that organizes related content around a central, broad topic, known as a pillar page. This pillar page links to multiple individual sub-topic articles, or cluster content, which provide in-depth information on specific aspects of the main topic. This structure helps search engines understand the breadth of your expertise and the relationships between your content, improving search visibility and user experience by making it easier to find comprehensive information on a subject.
acceptedAnswer.description: Topic cluster creation organizes content around a central pillar page and related sub-topics to improve search engine understanding and user experience.
